overview:
California's 3rd District leans Democratic by about six points, and incumbent Ami Bera is running for re-election against Republican Robb Tucker, a little-known challenger. Bera has raised about $1.4 million and holds roughly $1.65 million on hand, while Tucker has raised about $294,000 and ends with under $30,000. Outside spending in the race has been negligible on both sides.

No public general-election polling exists, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the stark fundraising gap, and the national environment, all of which favor the incumbent. Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price Bera near 96 percent, and the expected margin sits in the high teens. The race is rated Safe Democratic.
